## Professional Overview
Prayag N is a Full Stack & Systems Engineer with 3+ years of experience specializing in the Python (FastAPI) and React (TypeScript) ecosystems. He architectures high-performance generative AI automation pipelines, modular node-based interfaces, and scalable microservices. His engineering work includes building production systems serving over 65,000 active users with low-latency APIs and robust real-time communication.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Frontend Ecosystem:** React.js, React Native, TypeScript, Next.js, Remix, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Expo, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Material-UI.
- **Backend & APIs:** Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API architecture, Swagger/OpenAPI, WebSockets, Socket.IO.
- **Artificial Intelligence & GenAI:** Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows, Azure OpenAI, AnythingLLM, Vector Databases (ChromaDB), Prompt Engineering.
- **Databases & Caching:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase, Redis.
- **Cloud, DevOps & Tools:** Docker, Netlify, Render, Git, GitHub, Postman, Linux, OneSignal, LiveKit audio/video.
- **Fintech & Payment Gateways:** PhonePe SDK, Stripe, Razorpay.

## Key Projects & Production Systems
1. **Aroundme App (Software Developer):**
   - Scaled platform to 65,000+ downloads and achieved 42% engagement growth.
   - Engineered real-time location-based features ('Shoutouts' and 'Chitchats') using Socket.IO.
   - Integrated Google Maps, Mapbox, and Ola Maps for dynamic geolocation.
   - Implemented LiveKit for low-latency real-time audio calls.

2. **Go Shoppie (AI Shopping Assistant):**
   - Co-created Shoppie, an AI-driven shopping assistant for D2C brands deployed on Shopify.
   - Integrated AnythingLLM and Azure OpenAI for personalized product discovery and smart recommendations.
   - Multi-platform plug-and-play support across Shopify, web, and WhatsApp.

3. **EatPlek (Restaurant Reservation & Collaborative Ordering Engine):**
   - Architected a scalable RESTful API backend using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
   - Integrated real-time collaborative friend-cart ordering and PhonePe payment processing.
   - Handled push notifications via OneSignal and automated image optimization via Sharp & ImageKit.

4. **Enterprise GenAI & RAG Automation:**
   - Designed node-based visual workflow automation pipelines connecting LLM inference with vector search and relational databases.

## Services & Engineering Offerings
- **Full-Stack Application Development:** Building production-grade web and mobile applications from concept to deployment.
- **Generative AI & RAG Pipeline Architecture:** Connecting custom company knowledge bases with LLM models for intelligent agents, automated search, and chat.
- **API & Microservice Engineering:** Designing clean, secure, and documented RESTful APIs in FastAPI or Node.js.
- **Real-Time Systems:** WebSockets, chat engines, geolocation tracking, and low-latency audio/video streaming.
- **Database & Performance Optimization:** Schema design, indexing, caching, and query performance tuning.
